title: Jesus... I Finally Answered The Aunty 💍 Part 2
topic: part 2: at the next family lunch she finally answers the aunty who keeps asking when she will marry, gently and without shame

bible.text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... Aunty asked when I'm getting married. This time I answered her. 💍

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I said, "I'm not late, Aunty. God isn't running behind on me." The whole table went quiet.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You didn't fight her. You told the truth gently.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: My hands were shaking under the table.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Brave often shakes. You stayed kind and kept your dignity.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Last time you cried in the car. Today you answered softly, and that was strength.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who still gets asked at every wedding. 💍
